lines.en: I cross the field dragging my wooden sword.

lines.zh: 我的头盔是自己拼的，歪一点。
lines.en: My helmet is self-made and sits crooked.
I walk toward that village.
I skirt the crops so I don't tread them.
I keep my eyes ahead with every step.

lines.zh: 我从篱笆的缺口挤进去。
lines.en: I squeeze through a gap in the fence.

lines.zh: 我在门槛前压低了身子。
lines.en: I crouch low at the threshold.
I move along the wall, hand on my sword.
My boots are thick with soil.
I work my way over to the window.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压近那间屋子。
lines.en: I advance on the house step by step.
I swing the sword once to feel its weight.
I count the village dogs barking.
I check which window still glows.
I'm watching the village entrance.
There's a notch in the wooden blade.
I rest my sword across my knees.
I know this area; they don't.
I shake out my numb wrist.
I'm counting the lights in the houses.
I don't shout; shouting gets you nothing.
I crouch and rest a while.
Do you see my sword.
I raise my blade at you.
You're not from this village.
I'm waiting for you to strike first.
I pull my helmet down a little.

lines.zh: 这身破甲是我自己缝的。
lines.en: I stitched this ragged armor myself.
Do you mean to stand in my way.

lines.zh: 我的剑砍不了铁，砍得了人。
lines.en: My blade won't cut iron; it cuts people.

lines.zh: 他们不欢迎我，我也不稀罕。
lines.en: They don't welcome me, and I don't care.
Step aside and I'll leave you alone.
I spit the blood out and stand firm.
A crack opens in my armor.
I grit my teeth and raise the sword again.
I double over, nearly dropping my sword.

lines.zh: 我抹了一把嘴，手是红的。
lines.en: I wipe my mouth; my hand comes away red.
I glance down at the bleeding cut.
My knees have gone weak.
I brace on the wall and rise.
I can still swing a few more times.
I pull my helmet low and don't step back.
I don't eat these; I take other things.
You hold it up; I give it a look.
I flick it aside with my blade.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我换一趟。
lines.en: That's not worth the trip.

lines.zh: 我要的是力量，不是吃的。
lines.en: It's power I want, not food.
Don't try to bribe me.

lines.zh: 我用剑尖挑开你的东西。
lines.en: I flick your offering aside with my blade.
That won't buy my blade.
I laugh once, and it's dry.
Move it; don't block the door.
You hit me and I give half a step.
I raise the hilt to block.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的头盔歪了。
lines.en: The bump knocks my helmet crooked.
I give ground and come right back.
We hit shoulder to shoulder.

lines.zh: 我把你推开，没用多大力。
lines.en: I shove you off without much force.
We kick up dust.
I'm steady, sword still in hand.
You're stronger, and I'm not afraid.
I go around you and head in.

lines.zh: 她也是从村子里出来的。
lines.en: She came out of a village too.
Our blades are about the same length.

lines.zh: 我们分吃一块偷来的面包。
lines.en: We split a stolen loaf between us.
She splits what she took with me.
We don't talk; we watch the roads.
Her helmet sits straighter than mine.
We set off for the next place together.
She leads; I take the rear.

lines.zh: 这样的日子不知道还有多久。
lines.en: Who knows how long this lasts.
At night we sleep in turns.

lines.zh: 我一把抓起来塞进袋里。
lines.en: I snatch it up and stuff it in my bag.
This could trade for half a sack of grain.
I flip it up with my blade tip.
This can be traded for something.
I look at it and drop it.
I cover it with straw.

lines.zh: 它碰在盔甲上响了一声。
lines.en: It clinks against my armor.
I stuff the bag fuller.
I earned this myself.
I bury it in the stove ash.
Standing right there — perfect.
I raise my blade and point it at you.
The trip won't be wasted.
I don't shout; shouting brings them.
I shift my weight forward.
I'll take what's in your hands.
This village owes me.
You're calmer than most I've met.
You stand inside the door; I've noted it.
My wooden sword comes up first.
Don't think about calling anyone.
I'll hold this first strike.
My feet are already moving.

lines.zh: 你往门里缩，我就贴上去。
lines.en: You shrink toward the door; I close in.
I lower the blade tip a little.

lines.zh: 这条路今天得有人让开。
lines.en: Someone gives way on this road today.
I follow along the fence.
You back inside; I block the door.
Step by step, I don't run.
My blade is raised and hasn't come down.

lines.zh: 你手里没有像样的东西。
lines.en: You haven't anything worth a fight.

lines.zh: 我靠在门框边等你出来。
lines.en: I lean on the doorframe waiting for you.

lines.zh: 这条巷子只有我们两个。
lines.en: Only the two of us in this alley.
The door behind you is locked.
I change the angle of my blade.
You shouldn't have let them drive me out.
We're already very close.
My blade tip wavers at your chest.
I raise the sword above my shoulder.
I take the blade overhead.
You block; your grip goes numb.
Your blade rings; it's nearly gone.
Now all you can do is run.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴着你的脚跟。
lines.en: My shadow sticks to your heels.
I wait for your breathing to even out.
Now I strike.
I bring the sword down.
Wood on iron, and it bounces.
I strike your hand with the flat.
You're driven back to the wall.
The blade's poisoned; don't blame me.

lines.zh: 这一下划开了你的袖子。
lines.en: That opens your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我撞你的胸口，把你顶开。
lines.en: I ram your chest and push you off.
You blocked that one too.
I kick at your knee.
Your hand shakes once.
I switch the sword to my other hand.
That swing misses.

lines.zh: 我贴着门板绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I slip along the door to your flank.
You retreat; I take one step after.
I'll stop after this one.
I drive the hilt into your face.
You block high; I kick low.
I cut upward from below.
I put my weight behind that one.
You retreat; I press in.
I come out at the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我的剑是从别人手里拿的。
lines.en: This sword came from someone else's hand.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看这个村子。
lines.en: I raise my head and look at this village.

lines.zh: 这里的房子比我记得的好。
lines.en: These houses are better than I remember.
I tie my helmet tight.
I go around outside the wall.
I've walked this area many times.

lines.zh: 他们把我赶出来，我回来了。
lines.en: They drove me out; I've come back.
I walk the ridge slowly.
I look the entrance over first.
No one saw me come in.
I'm not leaving empty-handed this time.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的袖子，我拍打着退。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I beat it out and retreat.
I fall from the wall and roll twice.
Water closes over me; I grab at reeds.
The blast slams me into the woodpile.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.
The light makes my hand go slack.
Days without food and I can't hold the blade steady.
The thunder drops me to a crouch.

lines.zh: 虚空里我抓不到任何东西。
lines.en: In the void I can grab nothing.
